import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)

    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    wb_xml = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    rels_xml = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {rel.get("Id"): rel.get("Target") for rel in rels_xml}
    sheets = [(s.get("name"), s.get("{%s}id" % R)) for s in wb_xml.find("{%s}sheets" % M)]

    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in ss.findall("{%s}si" % M):
            shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{%s}t" % M)))

    grand_total = 0.0
    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map[rid]
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        print(f"--- Sheet: {name} ({target}) ---")
        rows = []
        for row in root.iter("{%s}row" % M):
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall("{%s}c" % M):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find("{%s}v" % M)
                f = c.find("{%s}f" % M)
                raw = v.text if v is not None else None
                if t == "s" and raw is not None:
                    val = shared[int(raw)]
                elif raw is None:
                    val = f.text if f is not None else ""
                else:
                    val = raw
                cells.append((ref, val))
            rows.append(cells)
            print(" | ".join(f"{r}={val!r}" for r, val in cells))
        numeric = []
        for cells in rows:
            for ref, val in cells:
                try:
                    numeric.append(float(val))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    pass
        sheet_total = sum(numeric)
        grand_total += sheet_total
        print(f"[sheet total of numeric cells: {sheet_total}]")
    print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL (all numeric cells across all sheets): {grand_total}")

from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    'm': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
}

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    print("Archive entries:", z.namelist())

    # Workbook: sheet names and relationship ids
    wb_xml = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    rels_xml = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rel_map = {rel.get('Id'): rel.get('Target') for rel in rels_xml}
    sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
              for s in wb_xml.find('m:sheets', NS)]
    print("Sheets:", sheets)

    # Shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in ss.findall('m:si', NS):
            shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))

    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map[rid]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
        data = z.read(target)
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
        print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} ({target}) ---")
        for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            vals = []
            for c in row.findall('m:c', NS):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', NS)
                f = c.find('m:f', NS)
                raw = v.text if v is not None else None
                if t == 's' and raw is not None:
                    val = shared[int(raw)]
                elif raw is None:
                    val = f.text if f is not None else ''
                else:
                    val = raw
                vals.append(f"{ref}={val!r}")
            print(" | ".join(vals))

import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
grand_total = 0.0
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"--- Sheet: {sheet} (shape {df.shape}) ---")
    print(df.to_string())
    numeric = df.select_dtypes(include="number").to_numpy()
    total = float(numeric.sum()) if numeric.size else 0.0
    grand_total += total
    print(f"[sheet total of all numeric cells: {total}]")
print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL (all numeric cells across all sheets): {grand_total}")
